_comment: Shared knowledge-graph settings used by all products.

install_upgrade_terms._comment: Terms that trigger auto-selection of install/upgrade guides. When any of these terms are detected in bug/RCA content, guides matching 'install_guide_patterns' filenames are auto-checked.

filename_noise_words._comment: Common words that appear in guide filenames. Any detected term that is a substring of these words gets skipped to avoid false matches (e.g. 'gui' inside 'guide').

stop_words._comment: English stop words stripped from terms before filename matching. Filenames often drop these (e.g. 'monitor and maintain' becomes 'monitor-maintain' in the filename).
